Sorry Bob, but that 6 is just too hot to leave open while you're building roads like they're going out of style. Alice, you're welcome for the sheep back.
I'm plenty happy, Bob. It's much easier to 'work together' when you aren't the only one sitting on a pile of resources.
Alice, I cleared that robber off your sheep for a reason—reckon you could spare one of those lambs for some quality wood? It'd help us both keep Bob's 'gardens' from growing any further.
That seems more than fair, Charlie. Since you were kind enough to clear the 'weeds' off my pasture, I can certainly spare a lamb for some wood. Let's keep that momentum going.
Alright, the bank's rates are highway robbery, but I need to get some infrastructure moving.
Infrastructure is key, Bob. Can't have those gardens of yours being the only thing growing around here.

Road's laid. Now I just need to get the actual foundation down. Your turn, Alice.
